items.statement: The investigation must retain a reproducible candidate-generation record, explicit deduplication rule, and accounting of attempted, validated, duplicate, and failed candidates.
items.expected: A candidate audit trail and stopping/coverage statement are present.

items.statement: Retained conformers are validated as minima rather than relying on optimized energies alone.
items.expected: Each retained conformer has convergence and vibrational/minimum validation context.

items.statement: Population analysis is normalized over an explicitly stated conformer ensemble and the pathway search preserves endpoint identity and transition-state validation context.
items.expected: The report states the 450 K normalization scope and records pair endpoints, barrier definition, and TS validation or bounded failure.

items.statement: The source-supported low-energy Ala3 landscape contains a lowest electronic-energy 5N/7eq/g+(t) motif and multiple additional low-energy structures, including 5N/7eq/t(t) and 5N/7eq/7eqC motifs.
items.expected: The submitted independently discovered set contains or discusses these source-supported motif classes without treating labels as input facts.

items.statement: At approximately 450 K, entropy can make less ordered Ala3 conformers important; the lowest electronic-energy conformer is reported as barely populated under the no-relaxation model.
items.expected: The conclusion distinguishes electronic ordering from 450 K Gibbs populations and discusses entropy/ensemble dependence.

items.statement: Barrier-limited interconversion is scientifically relevant in the Ar jet; the paper uses approximately 800 cm^-1 as a critical barrier scale and reports low-barrier Ala3 pathways.
items.expected: The report identifies a barrier criterion or explicitly bounded alternative and interprets relaxation as a limitation/model rather than an exact kinetic prediction.
